settings.subtaskDisplayHint: How a task's checklist shows on its card

main.this_week_hint: No day yet — drag onto a day when you're ready

category.help: Everything is shown. Click a category to hide it, or focus one on its own.
category.focused: Focused on {{name}} — every other category is hidden
category.name: Category name
category.empty: No categories yet. They colour your tasks and drive the filter.
category.day_limit_paid: A per-category daily limit is part of the paid plan.
category.private_hint: Never included in a shared week
category.event_keywords_placeholder: Calendar events containing… e.g. standup, 1:1, gym
category.event_keywords_hint: A calendar event whose title contains one of these words takes this category. Separate them with commas.

notes.title: Notes
notes.empty: No notes on this task yet.

history.title: History
history.empty: Nothing has changed on this task yet.
history.unavailable: History is kept on the server, so it needs a connection.

projects.title: Projects
projects.empty: No projects yet. A project is a list you pull tasks from into your week.
projects.name: Project name
projects.category_help: A project's category applies to every task in it.

leftovers.title: Left behind
leftovers.intro: Tick what you actually finished, drop what stopped mattering, and move the rest into this week.
leftovers.empty: Nothing was left behind. Every week before this one is clear.
leftovers.last_week_moved_one: task carried into a later week or Some day
leftovers.last_week_moved_other: tasks carried into a later week or Some day
leftovers.swipe_hint: Swipe sideways to skip a card. Tap to decide.

update.available: A new version of WeekPal is ready.

demo.reset_confirm: This clears the demo and loads the sample week again. Nothing you made here is kept.
demo.title: You're in demo mode
demo.subtitle: Take WeekPal for a spin — nothing here is permanent.
demo.point_local: Everything is stored locally, in this browser only.
demo.point_temporary: Changes aren't kept once you leave the demo.
demo.point_sample: The sample week is pre-loaded to show you around.
demo.callout: Ready to keep your week? Sign up — it takes a moment, and the demo data stays behind.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.intro: These act on the selected task. Click a task, or press j to start.
shortcuts.complete: Tick the selected task off, or put it back
shortcuts.defer: Push it to the next day, or to Some day
shortcuts.new: Add a task to the selected day
shortcuts.category: Focus its category, and leave focus again
shortcuts.escape: Close this list, or leave category focus
shortcuts.projects: Show or hide the projects drawer
shortcuts.estimate: Set an estimate, while estimating a day

install.title: Add WeekPal to your home screen
install.intro: It opens full screen, works offline, and keeps the week where you can reach it.
install.step_share: Tap the share button — the square with an arrow out of it.
install.step_confirm: Confirm the name, and it lands on your home screen.

limits.explain: It now holds {{planned}} of {{limit}}. Make room, or let something go — your task is already saved either way.

import.title: Import tasks
import.formats: CSV, XLSX or ODS. The first row should be your column headings — title, notes, category, date and a done column are recognised. Older .xls workbooks are a different format; Excel can save one as .xlsx.
import.undated: {{n}} had no usable date and went to Some day.
import.skipped: {{n}} rows had no title and were skipped.
import.failed: That file could not be imported. Check it has a column of task titles.
import.unavailable: Importing needs an account — the demo board has nowhere to import to.
import.unmatched: Columns it did not recognise: {{headers}}. Send us these and we can add them.
import.will_be_undated: {{n}} have no usable date and will all land in Some day.

share.title: Share this week
share.intro: Anyone with the link can see this week, read-only. Tasks in a private category are never included.
share.password_hint: Anyone opening the link has to type this first.
share.replace_warning: Creating a new link turns the old one off straight away.
share.unavailable_exhausted: This link reached its limit of opens.
share.error: That did not work. Try again in a moment.

deferral.escape_hint: Options for a task that keeps moving
deferral.escape_intro: “{{title}}” has moved {{count}} times. That usually means one of three things.

estimate.label: How long, roughly
estimate.batch_done: Every task on this day has an estimate

avoidance.title: What you've been carrying
avoidance.headline: You moved work {{moves}} times. {{open}} things are still open, {{chronic}} of them carried four times or more.
avoidance.too_early: There isn't enough history yet for this to say anything useful. Come back in a few weeks.
avoidance.pro_only: This report is part of Pro.
avoidance.error: That didn't load. Try again in a moment.

feedback.title: Tell us what happened
feedback.open: Report a problem or suggest something
feedback.placeholder_bug: What were you doing, and what happened instead?
feedback.error: That didn't send. Try again in a moment.
feedback.attached_one: {{count}} detail about your board is attached
feedback.attached_other: {{count}} details about your board are attached
feedback.no_tasks: Your tasks and their contents are never included.

changelog.title: What's changed
changelog.unavailable: The release notes couldn't be loaded. They'll be here next time you're online.

week.title: One week at a time
week.body: This is the week you're planning. The arrows move a week either way, and Today brings you back to this one.

columns.title: A column per day
columns.body: Write a task into the day you mean to do it. Drag it to another day when the day changes its mind — that's the whole idea.

buckets.title: For what has no day yet
buckets.body: This week holds things due before Sunday but not on any particular morning. Some day is the shortlist you're not working from yet.

leftovers.title: What you left behind
leftovers.body: Unfinished tasks don't quietly vanish at midnight. Once a week this shows you what's still waiting, and you decide where it goes.

settings.title: Make it yours
settings.body: Which days you work, how long a working day is, what counts as a full one. The release notes live here too.

day.title: One day at a time
day.body: A phone shows a single day: its tasks, and how full it already is.

tabs.title: The rest of the week
tabs.body: Every day is a tab along here, plus This week for what has no day and Some day for what has no week. Tap the week's name to come back to today.

menu.title: Everything else
menu.body: What you left behind, your settings, and the button for telling me something's broken.
